title: In-game log display
description: This module is suitable for yuba or developers. Its main function is to display real-time logs in the game
body:
This module is suitable for server administrators or developers. Its main function is to display real-time logs in the game, and it will automatically mark warnings (yellow) and errors (red).

Support the display of all logs and the sliding of mouse wheel. Note: You may need to adjust the interface size to fit the displayed size!
